## Description
Briefly describe the change and its rationale.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Cryptographic or security improvement

## Threat Model and Security Impact
- Does this change affect the hybrid key exchange, HKDF derivation, or AES-GCM framing?
- Are any new network sockets, telemetry, or endpoints introduced?

## Testing Performed
- [ ] Unit tests added / updated in `tests/`
- [ ] `make test` executed and passing
- [ ] `make lint` executed and passing
- [ ] Manual end-to-end testing performed

## Checklist
- [ ] Code follows project style conventions
- [ ] Self-review conducted
- [ ] Comments and docstrings updated
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, keys, or credentials committed
